items.title: Russia strikes Dnipro train station in central Ukraine, killing 14
items.brief: A Russian drone struck the main railway station in the central Ukrainian city of Dnipro as people waited to board a train on Thursday morning, killing 14 people.

items.title: Hegseth ousts Pentagon’s chief planner as renewed action against Iran looms, source says
items.brief: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth fired the Pentagon’s top planning officer as President Donald Trump weighs new strikes against Iran , according to a defense official and another source familiar with the matter.

items.title: Peptides could soon be easier to get in the United States. Here’s what to know
items.brief: The US Department of Health and Human Services posted a draft policy that would ease restrictions about how certain peptides may be created in the United States, essentially opening up access to them.

items.title: Judge sharply questions lawyers over request to remove Letitia James from Cornell sex assault investigation
items.brief: A New York judge on Thursday sharply questioned attorneys over a request to remove Attorney General Letitia James from her role as the special prosecutor investigating sexual assault allegations at Cornell University .

items.title: ‘Ghoul’ is a political insult with real bite
items.brief: The daylight is getting shorter, the wind is getting colder, and the date fast approaches when people are supposed to beware of “ghouls” — no, not October 31, but November 3, Election Day.
